hero_eyebrow: A historic space with a modern spirit
hero_lede: Every quote on this page is a verbatim Google review, trimmed only for length and never reworded. Den 1880 holds a 5.0 rating across 128 reviews. Most of them come from the coworking side of the building, so the wedding review leads and the rest are labelled for what they actually were.
objection_1_q: “Why is the wedding review on its own?”
objection_1_a: Because it is the only one from a couple who got married here, and we would rather lead with it honestly than pad it out with reviews of other events.
objection_2_a: They are banquets, parties and private events run by the same team in the same rooms. Labelled as such, so you can weigh them yourself.
objection_3_a: Den 1880's Google listing. The link at the bottom of the page opens it so you can read every review in full and in context.
wall_intro: Six short ones first, then the long reviews in full.
